narrative.overview: The home site is one powerlifting scoresheet seen once, not a landing page that quotes one. A night-gym ground (#21232e) carries a ruled grid of boxed fields, one condensed grotesque used across a wide width range, and three round referee lamps. Recognisable with every word removed: hairline boxes and three white circles. The offer is a filled-in attempt card whose last column is the percentile; the signup is the sheet's signature box.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline-ruled boxes in two tints; the grid is the ornament.
One family, Archivo variable, with the width axis (wdth 62 to 100) doing the work of a type pairing.
Numerals are tabular everywhere, so kg and percentile columns align.
Three inks only beyond neutrals: white lamps, blue for the score bar, orange for the action and the total.
Zero radius on every box; only the lamps are round.
Bilingual by markup: every string exists twice, the root data-l attribute hides one.

rules.name: The Three-Ink Rule
rules.body: Beyond neutrals, only white lamps, blue and orange appear, and each owns one job: lamps count a lift, blue measures the percentile, orange acts.

rules.name: The Blue Is Graphic Rule
rules.body: #105bff is never used for text; reading blue is #7aa2ff.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from font-stretch and weight on one family, never from adding a second typeface.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numbers align in columns; tabular-nums is set once on body and not overridden.

rules.name: The Hairline Depth Rule
rules.body: Containment is expressed by border tint: inner dividers in Rule, container edges in Rule Strong. Never by shadow.

dos: Do build every new surface from boxed, hairline-ruled fields: Rule inside, Rule Strong on the outer edge.
Do use one family with font-stretch for hierarchy: wdth 62 for titles, 70 for labels, 75 for figures and buttons, 100 for reading text.
Do keep orange for the single action and the total; blue only for measuring bars.
Do keep numerals tabular and aligned to the same .9rem inset as the field text.
Do light lamps once, in sequence, and disable the animation under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do ship both languages in the markup and let data-l select.
Do label demonstration data as SAMPLE in the sheet head.
donts: Don't introduce cards, icons, gradients, shadows, glows or rounded boxes; the first viewport must stay a scoresheet.
Don't add kicker or eyebrow lines above headings; field captions belong to a field box, not to a heading.
Don't set text in Meter Blue (#105bff); use Link Blue (#7aa2ff).
Don't add a second typeface or a light theme.
Don't add a second primary button style or more than one orange action per band.
Don't use more than one lamp sequence or loop it.
